name: Roomwell
eyebrow: Less in the way. More room to live.
headline:

intro: The old sofa. The packed garage. The items you keep meaning to move. Start with a clear list and a practical pickup plan.
about_title: A useful next step for the things in your way.
about_body: Roomwell is a fictional removal company with a friendly, practical approach. This template brings the item list, access questions and pickup preferences into one clear conversation.
tagline: Clear the space. Keep the possibilities.
split_title:
A little less clutter.
A lot more possibility.
split_body: A useful removal plan accounts for bulky items, stairs, parking and material restrictions. Donation and recycling options depend on item condition and local facilities; they are confirmed for each job.
services: Discuss sofas, tables and other bulky household items with attention to access, dimensions and the route out. Final acceptance and handling are confirmed by the provider.
Note stairs, narrow doorways and anything that needs disassembly.
Turn a pile into a plan.
Start with an item list and photos of the area. A real crew reviews volume, access, loading and material restrictions before providing a written estimate.
Separate items to keep before agreeing what is going.
A clearer way to clear out.
Discuss bagged general household material and suitable cardboard. Hazardous materials, liquids and restricted waste require an appropriate specialist.
Do not include chemicals, batteries, sharps or unidentified waste in this preview.
steps: Build a short sample inventory and add optional local photos.
A real provider confirms materials, stairs, parking and load size.
Confirm scope, disposal arrangements, price and timing before collection.
faqs: Do you take every type of material?
No. A real provider defines accepted and excluded materials. Hazardous or restricted waste needs the appropriate specialist.
